context: OSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3. DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS YUTIQ is a non-bioerodible intravitreal implant in a drug delivery system containing 0.18 mg fluocinolone acetonide, designed to release fluocinolone acetonide at an initial rate of 0.25 mcg/day, and lasting 36 months.
